description: This file is a makefile fragment used for configuring and building Linux kernel modules within the OpenWrt build system. It contains variable definitions, conditional logic for different architectures and build options, and functions for managing kernel modules and dependencies.

methods.name: collect_module_symvers
methods.description: Collects and sorts module version symbols from subdirectories and saves them into a Module.symvers file.

methods.name: KernelPackage/hooks
methods.description: Defines hooks for post-processing during kernel module compilation, specifically to collect module symbol versions.

methods.name: KernelPackage/Defaults
methods.description: Sets default values for kernel package configuration such as files, autoload, and module parameters.

methods.name: ModuleAutoLoad
methods.description: Creates autoload configuration files for kernel modules, handling module list, installation prefix, and boot flags.

methods.name: KernelPackage/depends
methods.description: Defines dependencies for the kernel package based on the kernel configuration.

methods.name: KernelPackage
methods.description: Main function to define a kernel package with all related configuration, dependencies, and installation procedures.

methods.name: AutoLoad
methods.description: Generates autoload parameters for modules, including priority and boot flags.

methods.name: AutoProbe
methods.description: Generates autoload parameters specifically for probing modules.

methods.name: CompareKernelPatchVer
methods.description: Compares kernel patch versions based on specified criteria.
